value.rationale: Petersen is the canonical smallest class-two cubic graph, so four colours are its minimal edge palette. General known Kempe connectivity leaves metric efficiency undetermined; radius seven, sharp diameter eight and only 2,880 diametral pairs, with sharp eccentricity/degree classes, give a natural quantitative classification of shortest recolouring sequences in a foundational graph and an exact benchmark for snark reconfiguration.
